record.title: Evaluate actual private ADC sequence evidence for stock admission
record.intent: Admit one bounded stock validation only if the observer has passed the required guest controls.
requirements: Distinguish preflight results, host synthetic checker tests and actual guest control evidence. Do not promote the first failed attempt into a native observer result.

If supported admit exactly one stock validation of the predicted whole sequence, with unchanged stock APK and library, explicit two synthetic logging readbacks, entry guards, full thread coverage and the unexecuted post-return PC0x333bac. No next-subsystem response is included.

Otherwise identify the smallest evidence-supported correction or architecture limitation. Draft, plan, inspect and admit any successor batch against the expected ledger revision; commit and push tasking before execution.
acceptance: An evidence-supported bounded continuation or precise unresolved limitation is committed and pushed.
